subject: reasoning
question: G, H, I, J, M, N and O are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table (but not necessarily in the same order). Only two people sit between O and J when counted from the right of O. Only three people sit between H and I when counted from the right of I. J sits to the immediate right of I. G sits to the immediate right of N. Who sits fourth to the right of M?
solution:
Given:

 G, H, I, J, M, N and O are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

Only two people sit between O and J when counted from the right of O.

Only three people sit between H and I when counted from the right of I.

J sits to the immediate right of I.

G sits to the immediate right of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c317441c05cdcb0d760bac14aee27f96b30176350432cf900bdcc876a2e04052.png] 

Thus, G sits fourth to the right of M.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
